Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...
Prim: El Asesinato de la Calle del Turco
Biopic histórica sobre el complot para asesinar al General Prim. La acción tiene lugar después del final de la revolución Gloriosa en 1868 y termina con la proclamación del rey Amadeo I de Saboya.

Una madre lucha por comprender el por qué su hija se retira a su propio mundo de silencio. La historia prosigue el trabajo de Ruth Matthews (Kathleen Turner) y su difunto esposo restaurando ruinas mayas, un trabajo que causó la muerte de él un año antes.
El Chico de la Burbuja de Plástico

Cuenta la historia de Tod Lubitch, un niño que nace con una deficiencia en su sistema inmunológico y que debe crecer y permanecer toda su vida confinado en un ambiente estéril. Pero se enamora y deberá elegir entre vivir plenamente o confinado.

Tras una reunion politica, Mateo Ibarra, alcalde de Fago, un pequeño pueblo del Pirineo aragones, regresa en su coche por una carretera angosta y nevada. A mitad del camino, unas piedras colocadas en la calzada le obligan a detener su vehiculo.

El hallazgo del coche del alcalde, abandonado lejos del pueblo, permite a los investigadores iniciar el análisis de restos genéticos, mientras el teniente Vidal y el sargento Pacheco interrogan a todo el pueblo y requisan las armas de caza.
Los altos mandos ya conocen la noticia: las muestras analizadas señalan a Eugenio Riaza como artífice del asesinato de Mateo Ibarra.

Deb and Wolfe were friends many years ago, and after reuniting 40 years later, they fall in love and get married; the couple is looking for a lakefront home where they can enjoy time with their blended family and have space for Deb's fashion career.

Amanda and Shawn are best friends and work colleagues; they are looking to pool their money together to buy a vacation lakefront property that gives them each space of their own; first, they view a fully restored house that was built in the 1960s.

Mike Holmes travels to the island of Hilton Head, S.C., to advise first-time home buyers Caroline and Diego during their search; Mike goes through their favorite houses to identify issues that could be detrimental to the couple and their children.

Looking for their forever home, Lindsay and Seth choose their favorite houses in Hilton Head, S.C.; Mike Holmes goes through the houses to help them select the best residence for their present budget as well as their future plans.

In St. Anthony, Minn., Rhonda and Leo look for a home that fits their budget and is perfect for their family; Mike Holmes goes through the prospective houses, pointing out the pros and cons and teaching Rhonda and Leo how to buy with confidence.
Mike helps Sam and Nick look at brand-new houses, many of which have yet to be lived in, which means all the more reason to bring along the King of Contractors.

In Brooklyn Park, Minn., Jake and Lindsay want to buy an investment home, and they show their favorites to Mike who helps them see the good, the bad and the ugly in order to get the best house for their money.

Brenda and Peter have two young daughters and love their Minneapolis neighborhood, but they've outgrown their home, and they need Mike's expertise as they view the new houses they're considering, hoping to pick the best home for their family.

In Florida, fun-loving Nicole and Tariq are ready to buy their first home, preferably with enough room for a future family; Mike tours Nicole and Tariq's chosen homes and teaches them how to spot what's good, what's fixable and what's unacceptable.
